descriptionChirho: A statement or reality that is contrary to truth; deception or falsehood as a concept or specific instance. Greek ψεῦδος covers both concrete lies and abstract falsehood. Multilingual evidence is unified: eng 'lie / of falsehood,' spa 'mentira / de mentira,' hin झूठ (jhūṭh), arb كَذِبًا/كَذِبٍ (kadhib in various cases), kor 거짓 (geojit, falsehood), swa 'uongo / ya uongo.' The two clusters differ only in grammatical case — accusative/nominative/dative (S79183) vs genitive (S79184) — representing the same lexical meaning.
